question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Neccessary"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "Necessary". (आवश्यक)
 
 
• **Example:** It is necessary to have a passport when traveling internationally.
 
 
 
• **"Necessary"** means required to be done, achieved, or present; needed; essential. (आवश्यक)
 
 
• **Example:** It is necessary to study hard to pass the exams.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Connoisseur** (पारखी): An expert judge in matters of taste.
 
 
• **Example:** He is a connoisseur of fine wines.
 
 
 
• **Privilege** (विशेषाधिकार): A special right, advantage, or immunity granted or available only to a particular person or group.
 
 
• **Example:** It is a privilege to serve in the community.
 
 
 
• **Dilemma** (दुविधा): A situation in which a difficult choice has to be made between two or more alternatives, especially ones that are equally undesirable.
 
 
• **Example:** She faced a dilemma about whether to accept the new job offer.
